title: Add Structured Request Logging Middleware with Correlation IDs
description: Introduce a lightweight, zero‑dependency middleware that assigns a unique correlation ID to each incoming request, logs request/response details in a structured JSON format, and propagates the ID downstream. This improves observability, aids debugging, and integrates with existing logging pipelines without adding runtime overhead.
testCases: Should generate a unique correlation ID per request and attach it to the request object
Should log request method, URL, status code, response time, and correlation ID in JSON format
Should preserve existing request properties and not interfere with other middleware
Should handle errors gracefully and still output a log entry
acceptance: When the server runs, every HTTP request results in a single JSON log line containing at least: timestamp, correlationId, method, url, status, responseTimeMs, and client IP. Correlation IDs are unique (no collisions in 10,000 rapid requests). Existing routes and middleware continue to function unchanged, and test suite passes with 100% coverage for the new middleware.
reason: Observability is a critical production need; without structured logs, troubleshooting latency or error spikes is time‑consuming. Adding this middleware delivers immediate operational value, aligns with the framework's zero‑dependency philosophy, and leverages the current routing/middleware architecture.
